subject.title: Standardize async resource lifecycle management across retry/cleanup paths

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a shared lifecycle/resource manager across agent, session, channel, and plugin cleanup paths, or continue using narrower owner-specific guards?
rationale: The current request crosses public plugin SDK, gateway channel shutdown, session lifecycle admission, and agent retry cleanup boundaries, so automation cannot safely choose the API shape or ownership model.

options.title: Keep as design tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers evaluate concrete failures such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101850 and decide whether a generic lifecycle seam is warranted.

options.title: Add a narrow SDK seam
options.body: Design a backward-compatible plugin/channel lifecycle API and prove it by migrating at least two affected owners with contract tests.

options.title: Close after targeted fixes
options.body: If maintainers decide existing owner-specific guards are the intended direction, close this with that rationale after linking the narrower fixed or open bug trackers.

recommendation.title: Keep as design tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers evaluate concrete failures such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101850 and decide whether a generic lifecycle seam is warranted.
